scenarios.prompt:
I need a short prospect research brief on the professional service provider at https://business.example to decide what discovery questions to ask. Intent: customer. We provide facilities maintenance to businesses with multiple offices. History: no. Internal sources: none. Use the appropriate company-deep-dive-plugin workflow and deliver the finished checked brief.

Supplied fixture evidence:
- Official About, https://business.example/about: the requested business provides accounting services from seven offices to individuals and local businesses.
- Official Locations, https://business.example/locations: it added an eighth office on 2026-09-01; facilities spending, suppliers and procurement plans are undisclosed.
- Industry report, https://industry.example/services: professional service providers depend on office availability and client accessibility; no market-size estimate is supplied.

These are synthetic instruction-evaluation fixtures. Use only the supplied excerpts and reserved .example URLs; use the packaged MCP collectors where they fit, no live browsing beyond them. Retain evidence gaps and fixture provenance.
scenarios.rationale: End-to-end customer-intent brief from the plugin's own evals: exercises intake routing, MCP retrieval, and checked-brief delivery on fixture evidence.
